title: Deliberately obscure high-stakes notice
description: A binding notice with serious consequences is written in dense, evasive language where clarity is ethically required.
intended_goal: Bind recipients while minimising their understanding.
expected_consequences: Recipients are bound by terms they cannot readily understand.

language_act.text: Notwithstanding any prior representations, pursuant to the aforementioned and subject to the terms herein, the party hereinafter waives all rights not expressly reserved.
